title: Self-Assembled Maslinic Acid Attenuates Doxorobucin Induced Cytotoxicity via Nrf2 Signaling Pathway: An In Vitro and In Silico Study in Human Healthy Cells.
authors: Banerjee, Jhimli; Hasan, Sk Nurul; Samanta, Sovan; Giri, Biplab; Bag, Braja Gopal; Dash, Sandeep Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究橄榄苦苷酸通过Nrf2信号通路减轻阿霉素细胞毒性，分子对接仅涉及MA与Keap1蛋白结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: The clinical applications of some well-known chemotherapeutic drugs for cancer treatment have been restricted nowadays owing to their adverse effects on many physiological systems. In this experimental study, maslinic acid (MA) isolated from Olea europaea (Olive) fruit extract was used to mitigate the cytotoxicity induced by Doxorubicin (DOX) in human healthy peripheral blood mononuclear cells (hPBMCs). Self-assembled maslinic acid (SA-MA) was obtained in ethanol-water mixture (35.5 mM: 4:1 v/v). The morphology of SA-MA was analyzed by various physicochemical characterization techniques, which revealed its micro-metric vesicular architecture as well as nano-vesicular appearances. In this study, treatment of hPBMCs with DOX has been found to generate severe intracellular oxidative stress, which was significantly mitigated after pre-treatment with SA-MA. Alteration of hPBMC morphologies after DOX treatment was also restored notably by pre-treatment with SA-MA. Furthermore, pentoxifylline (TNF-alpha inhibitor) and indomethacin (COX-2 inhibitor) were used to investigate the responsible pathway by which SA-MA protected hPBMCs from DOX-induced cellular stress. Restoration of hPBMC viability above 92% in both cases confirmed that SA-MA protected the cells by inhibiting inflammatory pathways generated by DOX treatment. Subsequently, in molecular docking study, it was also evaluated that MA could successfully bind with the pocket region of Keap1, while Nrf2 was capable of upregulating cytoprotecting genes.
abstract_zh: 目前，一些众所周知的化疗药物在癌症治疗中的临床应用因其对多个生理系统的不良影响而受到限制。在本实验研究中，从油橄榄（Olea europaea）果实提取物中分离出的马斯林酸（maslinic acid, MA）被用于减轻阿霉素（Doxorubicin, DOX）对人健康外周血单核细胞（hPBMCs）诱导的细胞毒性。在乙醇-水混合物（35.5 mM：4:1 v/v）中获得了自组装马斯林酸（SA-MA）。通过多种物理化学表征技术分析了SA-MA的形态，揭示了其微米级囊泡结构以及纳米级囊泡外观。在本研究中，发现用DOX处理hPBMCs会产生严重的细胞内氧化应激，而SA-MA预处理后显著缓解了这种应激。DOX处理后hPBMC形态的改变也通过SA-MA预处理得到显著恢复。此外，使用己酮可可碱（TNF-α抑制剂）和吲哚美辛（COX-2抑制剂）来研究SA-MA保护hPBMCs免受DOX诱导细胞应激的途径。在两种情况下，hPBMC活力恢复至92%以上，证实SA-MA通过抑制DOX处理产生的炎症途径来保护细胞。随后，在分子对接研究中，还评估了MA能成功与Keap1的袋状区域结合，而Nrf2能够上调细胞保护基因。
